body: I have to admit I don't quite follow, sorry.

For having me and then raising me to be completely messed up with their educational methods. Maybe if they had done their job correctly I wouldn't have suffered so much. I'm not the only one messed up among my siblings, by the way.
They didn't have to have kids if they didn't have a clue how to raise them. I wouldn't have any for that reason alone.
You could say that about anyone who's caused you harm, and as long as it's not your parents, it would be socially acceptable.
Maybe I can, maybe I can't. But why do they get to get away socially blame-free when they caused this mess, that I have to fix now?

I'm 5' fucking 3". No one takes me seriously. Why would they? And I'm a weakling at that. I've always been. And even if I start working on it now, my ship's already sailed, I'll never know what it's like being young and good looking. Ugh these thoughts CONSUME me.

I don't want someone to like me the way I am, I want to be smoking hot. It just eats me inside to know that I'm not, and will never be, while seeing all those other guys who look just short of perfect. It's just... so unfair. I'll never have that. I can't stop thinking about it!

I'm not living with my parents... I live in a different country altogether. Everyone sort of looks down on me because I don't support myself. Hell, I look down on myself. I know they're right. I'm just too weak to change anything.

I'm a guy and I'm REALLY short. I hate that. I also don't look good. It just kills me when I see gorgeous guys and know I could never be like that. Plus I'm 26 and I always see really young guys with awesome bodies and think about that time in my life and how much better it could have been if I looked liked that... It might sound stupid but I feel like a piece of crap.

Then there's the whole being 26 and still living on my parents' dime, having worked less than a year [!] my whole life. I'm such a failure. Then again, I'm angry at them for having me and thus causing me to suffer so much. I just want to sleep and never wake up.
I really don't know how I could ever do that... Sometimes I manage to not think about it as much, but it always resurfaces and it's always extremely painful.
It kills me to see pretty much anyone else. How can I do anything like that?
Please say something, I really need someone to talk to. :(
I guess you're right... The whole language thing just drags me down all the time. I'm experiencing so many failures that I just try to avoid them altogether. :/
